title: Preserve exact source
title_my: မူရင်းစာသားကို ထိန်းသိမ်းပါ။
guidance: Keep bytes, names, numbers, punctuation and quotations unchanged. Return suggestions separately; never normalize or convert encoding silently.
exceptions: Preserve intentional source forms; proposals require contextual and user authorization. Do not infer Burmese from script alone.
verification: static-contract plus target-host/native review where required

title: Language is not script
title_my: ဘာသာစကားကို အတည်ပြုပါ။
condition: Myanmar script input without an explicit language
guidance: Ask whether the text is Burmese; Myanmar script also serves other languages. Support only explicit my or my-MM here.
exceptions: Preserve intentional source forms; proposals require contextual and user authorization. Do not infer Burmese from script alone.
verification: static-contract plus target-host/native review where required

title: Encoding uncertainty
title_my: ကုဒ်စနစ်ကို အလိုအလျောက် မပြောင်းပါနှင့်။
guidance: Record encoding as unknown and request provenance or specialist detection. A UTF-8 decode does not prove Unicode Myanmar; detection is probabilistic. Keep conversion as an approved separate candidate.
exceptions: Preserve intentional source forms; proposals require contextual and user authorization. Do not infer Burmese from script alone.
verification: static-contract plus target-host/native review where required

title: Protect shaping clusters
title_my: ပေါင်းစပ်အက္ခရာများကို မခွဲပါနှင့်။
condition: Tracking, slicing, colored spans or animation affects Myanmar text
guidance: Do not split at code-point counts or insert spaces between marks. Inspect shaping and orthographic syllables in the target engine; generic graphemes alone do not certify safety.
exceptions: Preserve intentional source forms; proposals require contextual and user authorization. Do not infer Burmese from script alone.
example: က္က ကိ ကီ ကု ကူ ကေ ကျ ကြ
verification: static-contract plus target-host/native review where required

title: Meaningful line breaks
title_my: အဓိပ္ပာယ်အလိုက် စာကြောင်းခွဲပါ။
guidance: Use language-aware break candidates and review phrase meaning and clusters. Never adopt break-all or equal-character slicing as Burmese defaults; dictionary segmentation can miss names.
exceptions: Preserve intentional source forms; proposals require contextual and user authorization. Do not infer Burmese from script alone.
verification: static-contract plus target-host/native review where required

title: Spaces are not word counts
title_my: စကားလုံးအရေအတွက်ကို နေရာလွတ်ဖြင့်သာ မတွက်ပါနှင့်။
guidance: Burmese spaces often mark phrases. Do not count whitespace tokens as lexical words or insert spaces after every syllable.
exceptions: Preserve intentional source forms; proposals require contextual and user authorization. Do not infer Burmese from script alone.
example: မြန်မာစာ ရေးသားခြင်း
verification: static-contract plus target-host/native review where required

title: Punctuation and digit identity
title_my: ပုဒ်ဖြတ်ပုဒ်ရပ်နှင့် ကိန်းဂဏန်းများကို ထိန်းသိမ်းပါ။
guidance: Keep ၊ and ။, Myanmar digits and Latin digits as supplied. Confirm numeral policy for amounts, IDs and phones; never substitute ဝ for ၀ or reverse them.
exceptions: Preserve intentional source forms; proposals require contextual and user authorization. Do not infer Burmese from script alone.
verification: static-contract plus target-host/native review where required

title: Register by audience
title_my: ဖတ်ရှုသူနှင့် ရည်ရွယ်ချက်ကို စစ်ဆေးပါ။
condition: Copy editing or UI wording is requested
guidance: Confirm speaker, reader, purpose and register. Written text is not necessarily literary; do not mechanically replace သည် with တယ် or နဲ့ with နှင့်. Native review of proposed copy remains needed.
exceptions: Preserve intentional source forms; proposals require contextual and user authorization. Do not infer Burmese from script alone.
example: သည် တယ် နှင့် နဲ့
verification: static-contract plus target-host/native review where required

title: Preserve predicate meaning
title_my: စာကြောင်း၏ အဓိပ္ပာယ်ကို ထိန်းသိမ်းပါ။
condition: Shortening a heading or call to action
guidance: Check predicate, conditions, politeness and intent before proposing shorter copy. Do not import English word order or remove sentence endings just to fit a box.
exceptions: Preserve intentional source forms; proposals require contextual and user authorization. Do not infer Burmese from script alone.
verification: static-contract plus target-host/native review where required

title: Correct language tags
title_my: ဘာသာစကား အညွှန်းကို စစ်ဆေးပါ။
guidance: Use my/my-MM for known Burmese and appropriate tags for English spans. MM is a region, not the language; an observed mm-MM or en page tag is not a standard.
exceptions: Preserve intentional source forms; proposals require contextual and user authorization. Do not infer Burmese from script alone.
verification: static-contract plus target-host/native review where required

title: Font coverage and fallback
guidance: Compare Myanmar shaping coverage and Latin fallback at actual sizes. Noto Sans Myanmar, UI, Serif and Padauk differ; a matching em value does not imply matching visible size or safe line height.
exceptions: Preserve intentional source forms; proposals require contextual and user authorization. Do not infer Burmese from script alone.
verification: static-contract plus target-host/native review where required

title: Clipping is a target test
title_my: စာလုံးများ ပြတ်တောက်ခြင်း ရှိမရှိ စစ်ဆေးပါ။
condition: Buttons, tables, fixed boxes or exports
guidance: Inspect top/bottom marks, fallback, line boxes and stacked forms at target size. Neither font metrics nor a small test corpus establishes a universal minimum line height.
exceptions: Preserve intentional source forms; proposals require contextual and user authorization. Do not infer Burmese from script alone.
verification: static-contract plus target-host/native review where required

title: Contextual size proposal
title_my: စာလုံးအရွယ်ကို အသုံးပြုမည့်နေရာအလိုက် စမ်းသပ်ပါ။
guidance: As a comparison only, BBC static declarations used body 16/28px below 600px and 18/32px above, H1 30/44 and 44/72. Try context-appropriate values and verify your font, corpus and viewport; these are not national averages or verified rendering.
exceptions: Preserve intentional source forms; proposals require contextual and user authorization. Do not infer Burmese from script alone.
verification: static-contract plus target-host/native review where required

title: Reading versus graphic role
title_my: ဖတ်ရန်စာနှင့် အလှဆင်စာကို ခွဲခြားပါ။
condition: Display lettering, campaign or expressive heading
guidance: Choose a reading, expressive or hybrid role. Keep conditions and instructions readable as text; experimental vowel separation or distortions need native legibility review, not automatic approval.
exceptions: Preserve intentional source forms; proposals require contextual and user authorization. Do not infer Burmese from script alone.
verification: static-contract plus target-host/native review where required

title: Responsive roles differ
title_my: ခေါင်းစဉ်နှင့် ကိုယ်ထည်စာကို သီးခြား စမ်းသပ်ပါ။
condition: Hierarchy across narrow and wide layouts
guidance: Adjust heading/body ratio, line height and line count independently. Avoid shrinking a banner so conditions become unreadable; preserve equivalent readable content.
exceptions: Preserve intentional source forms; proposals require contextual and user authorization. Do not infer Burmese from script alone.
verification: static-contract plus target-host/native review where required

title: Accessibility checks are explicit
title_my: လက်တွေ့ အသုံးပြုနိုင်မှုကို စမ်းသပ်ပါ။
guidance: Test 200% text resizing separately from 400% zoom/reflow, user spacing, screen reading and keyboard tasks in the real client. WCAG spacing values are user-override tests, not universal author typography prescriptions.
exceptions: Preserve intentional source forms; proposals require contextual and user authorization. Do not infer Burmese from script alone.
verification: static-contract plus target-host/native review where required

title: Do not count ch as characters
title_my: ch ကို အက္ခရာအရေအတွက်ဟု မယူဆပါနှင့်။
guidance: ch normally follows the zero glyph advance, not a Burmese character count. Compare actual phrases and font fallback rather than claiming a universal 60ch line length.
exceptions: Preserve intentional source forms; proposals require contextual and user authorization. Do not infer Burmese from script alone.
verification: static-contract plus target-host/native review where required

title: Office and PDF evidence
title_my: PDF နှင့် စာရွက်စာတမ်းကို သီးခြား စစ်ဆေးပါ။
guidance: Check font availability/license and embedding, shaping, extraction, copy/paste, slide-distance readability and page breaks in the actual host. Static source PASS is not Office/PDF acceptance.
exceptions: Preserve intentional source forms; proposals require contextual and user authorization. Do not infer Burmese from script alone.
verification: static-contract plus target-host/native review where required

title: Rights without bundled fonts
guidance: Check exact font version and embedding/redistribution license. No third-party font, portfolio image or research figure is bundled by this product.
exceptions: Preserve intentional source forms; proposals require contextual and user authorization. Do not infer Burmese from script alone.
verification: static-contract plus target-host/native review where required

title: Read-only review report
guidance: Report rule/source IDs, location, evidence, suggested action and uncertainty without editing. Mark native rendering, encoding identification, proofing and host invocation not_checked until actually performed.
exceptions: Preserve intentional source forms; proposals require contextual and user authorization. Do not infer Burmese from script alone.
verification: static-contract plus target-host/native review where required
